name: Customer completes a Stripe Test Mode booking payment

planSteps.description: Navigate to the local Brash3D booking page at /. Confirm the page is using the local TestSprite tunnel, not a production URL.
Verify that the booking form shows the optional Referral code field alongside customer details.
Select an available Nike Sawgrass time slot and enter unique, clearly fake local test customer data. Do not enter a referral code for this payment-flow test.

Submit the booking form and continue to Stripe-hosted Checkout. Complete payment only with Stripe's public Test Mode Visa card 4242 4242 4242 4242, a future expiry date, any three-digit CVC, and a clearly fake billing identity. Never use a real card or live credentials.
After the Stripe Test Mode success redirect, verify the app returns to the secure customer session page and initially displays its booking-payment processing state.

Wait up to 20 seconds for the locally forwarded, signature-verified Stripe webhook. Verify the booking becomes confirmed and the customer session page is available. Record a failure if the webhook does not confirm the booking.
